name: [R33] Server/production host connects to an external webhook / request-capture / OAST service
message:
A server-zone host connected to an external webhook, request-capture, or OAST service. GTIG/Mandiant ("ARTEX and Friends", 2026-10-30) report threat actors operating ARTEX in real intrusions using webhook.site as a destination for results. Only webhook.site is named in the report; the other hosts are well-known services of the same kind, illustrative and not exhaustive.

Tune: developers testing webhooks on a mis-tagged staging/developer host are the main false positive; allowlist known sources. Tunneling and file-transfer services are not covered.

queries.name: server_webhook_oast_egress
queries.query: source:proxy @src.zone:(server OR production OR backend OR dmz) @destination.hostname:(webhook.site OR *.webhook.site OR interact.sh OR *.interact.sh OR oast.fun OR *.oast.fun OR oast.live OR *.oast.live OR oast.site OR *.oast.site OR oast.online OR *.oast.online OR oast.pro OR *.oast.pro OR oast.me OR *.oast.me OR pipedream.net OR *.pipedream.net OR requestcatcher.com OR *.requestcatcher.com OR burpcollaborator.net OR *.burpcollaborator.net OR beeceptor.com OR *.beeceptor.com)

cases.name: Server-zone host reached an external webhook / request-capture / OAST service
